nodes.label: Case Detail UI - Legal Case Timeline & Vendor Dispute Summary
nodes.description: Partial screenshot of a case detail view in the Captio web application. Shows a legal/vendor dispute case section with structured bullet points covering: Key Leverage (performance bond issued by Sureste Bonding, penalty clause 0.5% per week totaling ~$18,000 for 20 weeks, scope approval, 47 documented incident reports with verification); Vendor Response (counterparty offered 20% discount, releasing performance bond rejected by client); Vendor Counterclaim Risk (NovaSoft may allege scope changes, confirming changes were approved within original scope). Below that is a TIMELINE section showing two events: 'Consultation booked for tuesday' at 6/4/2026 2:48:20 PM and 'Demo client created' at 6/4/2026 2:44:05 PM. UI uses a light card layout with blue timeline dots, gray timestamps, and bold section labels.
nodes.ui_purpose: case detail panel showing legal leverage points, vendor negotiation status, and activity timeline
